featured_reviews.review_text:
Sharing a serious and unresolved issue involving both a shipping line and a marine insurer, highlighting significant gaps in accountability and claims handling.
Two containers were shipped together on the same voyage with Interasia Lines Ltd. One container was delivered in sound condition, while the other arrived totally damaged at destination. In accordance with standard procedures, a damage survey was conducted within 24 hours of receipt.
The shipment was insured with TATA AIG Insurance under ICC (A) – All Risks cover, including War Risk policy. A marine insurance claim was duly lodged (Claim No. 4300160663A) with all documents that were available and requested at the time. The last communication from TATA AIG was on 02/06/2025, and the claim remains unsettled.
Despite:
ICC (A) All Risks coverage,
Timely damage survey, and
Clear evidence of selective damage (one container intact, one totally damaged),
Interasia Lines Ltd. has declined responsibility for the cargo damage, and TATA AIG Insurance has failed to bring the claim to a fair and timely conclusion.
For exporters and businesses, marine insurance and reliable shipping are meant to provide protection—not prolonged uncertainty. This experience raises serious concerns about post-shipment accountability, claims efficiency, and customer commitment.
This is shared in the interest of awareness and accountability, with the expectation that both parties act responsibly and resolve genuine cargo damage claims.

Absolutely terrible experience with Liberty Insurance. From the start, the communication was disorganised and unprofessional. Getting a claim processed was like pulling teeth, endless delays, repeated requests for the same documents, and zero accountability from their team.

Customer service is non-existent  every time I called, I was passed from one agent to another, none of whom had any clue about the status of my case. Promises were made and broken repeatedly, and it honestly felt like they were doing everything possible to avoid paying out the claim I was rightfully entitled to.

It’s incredibly frustrating and disappointing to deal with a company that shows such little regard for its customers' time, money, or peace of mind. Avoid Liberty Insurance at all costs — you’ll thank yourself later.

featured_reviews.name: jihesh kp
featured_reviews.review_text:
I also need to highlight the major problems I faced with Liberty Insurance, which the Kuttipuram service center kerala,
aggressively promoted as the best option.
The service center convinced me to switch to Liberty
Insurance this year, claiming it offered the best customer service and seamless claims processing. However, my experience was the exact opposite.

I have filed two insurance claims through Liberty, both of which were extremely disappointing.
Recently, I filed a claim for an accident, and they rejected my claim for a minor projection in the alloy, a crucial part of the repair.
They only approved minor patchwork repairs, and even this approval took an unreasonable amount of time.
It took over a month of constant follow-ups, calls, and emails to both the service center and the insurance company just to get a response regarding my claim.
